task.title: HealthKit Sep24 decode fix + workout-type fidelity, both candidates reviewed

result.summary: Claude implemented, tested, and had independently fresh-context reviewed (APPROVE on both) the proven Sep24 Training Detail decode fix (Native: confirmedAt made optional, candidate fields added, plus a second transport-struct gap the implementer found and closed) and prospective HealthKit workout-type fidelity (Native: captures HKMetadataKeyIndoorWorkout only; Server: accepts and classifies it into a specific canonicalType without ever changing the cardio family). One real follow-up defect found by the first review round -- a hardcoded 'Confirmed' label that would have misrepresented an unconfirmed candidate match -- was fixed and re-verified before finalizing. Code/test/review only. Neither final candidate pushed, deployed, uploaded, or activated. The Midweek lane's live worktree was not touched.

unexpected_findings: The Native decode fix has a second, independent transport gap: a distinct, narrower wire-encoding struct (separate from the in-memory query-client model) is what actually gets sent to the Server, and it also needed the new indoor/outdoor field threaded through -- found and fixed by the implementer, independently confirmed by the reviewer tracing the real network encode/send call chain.

The first fresh-context Native review found a real, in-scope defect the implementation itself didn't introduce but made newly reachable: a hardcoded 'Confirmed with Workout Logger' label that would have misrepresented the Founder's real, unconfirmed Sep24 match as confirmed. Fixed with a 2-line label branch plus 2 new tests before finalizing.

The Server-side request-bounds byte-budget accounting needed a small, necessary extension to correctly account for the new field -- found by the implementer, confirmed additive-only and non-shrinking of other fields' budget by the reviewer.
